blocking_findings.finding: The native staging file handles are opened with GENERIC_READ only and the staging directory handle is opened without WRITE_DAC, but apply_worker_transaction_dacl uses SetSecurityInfo to set a protected DACL on those handles. Setting a DACL requires WRITE_DAC. Independent scratch-file and scratch-directory probes using the exact access masks both returned Win32 status 5, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED.
blocking_findings.impact: reserve_worker_outputs fails on the first staging file and wmain cleans up before launch_worker. Even if that call were skipped, the staging-directory DACL call fails for the same reason. The promised protected staging transaction and any later proxy invocation are unreachable; V3r29 staging blocker A02 is structurally improved but not operationally closed.
